name: Tinker Nano-Repair Tech regenerates a Tinker with no pet (#2237)
contract: #2237: Nano-Repair Tech (681358) is a passive whose Spell.dbc effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL with Amplitude 8000 and TriggerSpell 681516. 681516 heals a percentage of maximum health twice: effect 0 at TARGET_UNIT_CASTER and effect 1 at TARGET_UNIT_PET. Spell::CheckCast rejects a cast whose TargetA is TARGET_UNIT_PET while the caster has no guardian pet or charm, and Spell::prepare runs that check for triggered casts too, so the whole tick was discarded and the caster's own share never ran. A Tinker with no permanent pet is an ordinary state, so the tick must still reach Spell::cast. Fail-before proof: with no guardian pet, the count of spells this aura triggered is zero on the current code and at least one after the fix.

steps.label: The Tinker has no guardian pet, which is what aborted the cast
Nothing has been triggered before the passive is known
Nano-Repair Tech is active on the Tinker
Its period is the authored 8 seconds
The periodic heal runs although the Tinker has no pet
No pet appeared during the test
